title: Returning a promise from then
statement:
What does this code print, one letter per line (Node.js 22, run as a script with node main.js)?

Promise.resolve()
  .then(() => { console.log("a"); return Promise.resolve(); })
  .then(() => console.log("b"));
Promise.resolve()
  .then(() => console.log("c"))
  .then(() => console.log("d"))
  .then(() => console.log("e"))
  .then(() => console.log("f"));
choices: a c b d e f
a b c d e f
a c d b e f
a c d e b f
